name: scMTNI
method_summary: scMTNI jointly infers cell type-specific directed gene regulatory networks from single-cell omics data using a multi-task learning framework that shares information along a cell lineage. The method can additionally incorporate prior networks such as motif-derived evidence for each group.

threading.upstream_mapping: scMTNI's public C++ executable exposes no in-process thread flag, but upstream documents target-gene parallelism by splitting the -n target orthogroup file and launching separate public scMTNI runs. The wrapper maps ANDREA --threads to up to that many concurrent scMTNI processes, each with a disjoint target_ogids shard, isolated runtime config, raw output directory and log. BLAS/OpenMP-style environment variables are pinned to 1 inside each process; shard raw outputs are preserved under raw/shards/ and concatenated into raw/merged/ before exporting network.csv. Current cost profiles cover 1, 2, 4 and 8 assigned threads.

required.usage: Wrapper uses groups.tsv to map expression samples/cells to scMTNI clusters, create per-cluster expression inputs, and define native multitask output contexts.
Wrapper maps tf_list entries to expression genes and orthogroup IDs, then writes the upstream TF set used by scMTNI for per-cluster regulator-target models.

conditional_required.usage: Required when indep=false because scMTNI needs the lineage tree/dynamics file to share information across related clusters.
Required when q>0 because scMTNI's prior-weighted objective consumes group-specific regulator-target prior files.

progress.note: Progress reports lifecycle phases and completed target-gene shards. scMTNI's native iteration logs are preserved in scmtni.log and per-shard logs, but the parallel wrapper does not claim a stable iteration counter across concurrent shard processes.

x.description: Maximum number of regulators considered per target gene.

p.description: Root prior probability that an edge exists in the lineage root cell type.

b.description: Sparsity prior (beta0). More negative values produce sparser networks.

q.description: Motif prior weight (beta1). Use 0 when motif prior is not available.

indep.description: If true, runs INDEP mode (single-cell-type version). If false, lineage_tree is required.

split_genes.description: If true, enables split-gene mode (-c yes) expected by the scMTNI preprocessing format.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined stdout/stderr execution log from scMTNI.
Runtime helper inputs generated by the wrapper for scMTNI.

Raw outputs generated by the scMTNI executable. For multi-thread runs, per-shard upstream outputs are preserved under raw/shards/ and wrapper-concatenated outputs used for normalization are written under raw/merged/.
